limits: No full Kubernetes/CSI/Candidate worker live test was rerun in this increment. Worker/server wiring compiled with all targets; local journal recovery was exercised by the root node fixture.
No node reboot or power-loss test, and no durability SLA across faulty disks/filesystems. Configure root-owned node-local durable storage.
No persistent node supervisor, journal garbage collection/quota, off-node replication, or durable storage fence.
Recovery observations do not accept outputs, grant replacement execution, signal old PIDs, or release a writer. Execution remains Unknown and writer remains Draining.
Filesystem reads run after authority lowering/conditional cleanup with a five-second wait budget; a blocked syscall is not cancellable and runtime shutdown may wait.
